item.title: First SCP: An Interdimensional Internet Router
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Technological, Interdimensional, Mystery

Page Layout (Optional): Article followed by session logs

Elevator Pitch: A normal looking internet router that when connected to will connect your devices to the internet of a similar dimension or timeline to our own.

Central Narrative: These will have varying differences in terms of technological advancement, society, politics, geography, evolutionary psychology, et cetera. The only definite similarity to our reality being that each would have technologically progressed to the point of inventing their version of the internet. Each instance of a dimension will change every time the router is rebooted or powered down.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: There will be a log of sessions recorded by staff that have used this SCP to observe these realities and the differences in them. The reader can see instances of realities twith only minor differences (such as an instance where the US won the Vietnam War), to those that vary massively in a range of aspects (such as an instance where the continent Pangea never broke apart, and a species analogous to Humans evolved and formed societies and nations, with warfare being rarer due to differences in evolutionary psychology, and had progressed to a similar era with technology such as the internet).

Those examples were only quick ideas and aren't definite.

Additional Notes: I already began working on the draft as I had rushed into it, being unaware that I needed approval first. I hope that is fine, and you guys will find this to be an interesting (and original) idea for an SCP.
